notes.title: "Bye"-Hu Challenge - Breakers Collection Team Battle Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41420145/b49492ea70210822710b29048b9802b73f7598e4.png[/img]

The Team Battle mode is exclusive to the Breakers Collection and has been highly praised by the community. With that in mind, we thought we'd reward players who successfully complete Team Battle (on any difficulty).

Between January 27th and January 30th. Players who defeat Bai-Hu in Team Battle will receive an item to customize their Player Profile!

To prove you've completed the challenge, you need to post a clip of the last round of the fight on Twitter and don’t forget to tag us: @qubytegames. 

IMPORTANT: Only players who share in the victory on Twitter will be selected to receive the Player Profile customization item.

notes.title: Breakers Collection is OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
Hi Breakers Fans!

Thank you so much to everyone who followed our Breakers Collection development journey and it is with great affection that we announce today that one of the most beloved games in arcades is available for all players!

[previewyoutube=hhbLiZiJU-8;full][/previewyoutube]

Breakers Collection is an action-fighting game, with a roster with many playable characters (10 in Breakers Revenge), that were all known by the fans from around the world.

The special actions are also similar to other fighting games from the same era, although the dashing and back-stepping techniques tend to differ between characters.

Have the opportunity to play the classic Versus Mode local or with online lobbies, Arcade Mode, Ranked battles with Rollback Netcode (GGPO), Team Battle, Art gallery, Training mode and more!

We appreciate everybody’s interest and support!
Enjoy!

Join our Discord to chat with the devs and other players: [url=https://discord.gg/qubyte]https://discord.gg/qubyte[/url]

notes.title: Breakers Collection available January 12 on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch
notes.content:
Welcome to the official Breakers Collection Steam page!

The game will be available for $19.99 across all platforms on January 12th, 2023!

Breakers Collection is an action-fighting game, with a roster with many playable characters (10 in Breakers Revenge), that were all known by the fans from around the world.

The special actions are also similar to other fighting games from the same era, although the dashing and back-stepping techniques tend to differ between characters.

In this collection, the player will have the opportunity to play the classic Versus Mode local or with online lobbies, Arcade Mode, Ranked battles with Rollback Netcode (GGPO), Team Battle, Art gallery, Training mode and more!

notes.title: Breakers Collection first Closed Beta kicks off this Friday!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=NZnkBGr-5Bw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Breakers Fans!

We're ready to test the Breakers with you guys and to celebrate the occasion, we're extending registrations to the Closed Beta until February 17, so more fans of the Fighting Game genre have the chance to experience, first-hand, Breakers Collection Online modes with integrated matchmaking and Rollback Netcode.

You can register [url=https://www.qubyteinteractive.com/games/breakers/]HERE[/url]

This first Beta is aimed at testing the Online Features, hence Online Versus will be the only mode available at this time, but for the final version of the game, players can expect a slew of content from single-player Arcade to Local Versus Modes, from Online Versus to Training Modes, from Social to Ranked Matches and much more. 

Breakers Collection features both Breakers and Breakers Revenge, cult-classics among the fans of the genre, with all the original content as released in the 1990s for the Neo Geo and Arcades, as well as brand new content, such as Online and Training Modes, to offer fans of the originals and newcomers alike the ultimate Breakers experience.

Breakers Collection will be available on PC, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo SwitchTM in 2022.

[previewyoutube=7H5-tKd_mDM;full][/previewyoutube]


Breakers is a 2D fighting game released by Visco, on December 17, 1996, for the Neo Geo and Arcades in Japan. It features a roster of eight playable characters, from all over the world, competing against each other in a fierce tournament. A sequel, Breakers Revenge, was released on July 3, 1998, with additional playable characters, balance adjustments and new gameplay elements. Breakers has gained a cult following since its original release in Japan due to its solid gameplay and unique elements.
